interpretation: JSON object mode removed the syntax failure class entirely (8 of 9 outputs were valid JSON; the ninth was cut off). The remaining failures are contract-level: the model cannot reliably copy near-identical 40-character window ids, omits an optional-looking key when abstaining, and is verbose or fabricates when the context lacks an answer. evidence_first abstains more (safer on unanswerable, over-cautious on answerable); concise answers more and fabricates more.
proposed_next_change_set_for_pilot_2: A. Short evidence aliases in the model context (E1..E5) mapped back to real window ids by the application before validation; the verbatim-quote check is unchanged. Addresses 3 misattributions and the invented-hash id.

B. Instruction: limitations is mandatory in every response, including insufficient_evidence; quotes at most 240 characters; at most 6 claims. Enforced in validate_answer. Addresses the schema miss and the verbosity that caused the cutoff.

C. Evaluation policy: a completed response with finish_reason=length is an observed malformed answer (output_validation class), not an infrastructure failure; the paired run continues and counts it. Addresses the run stopping at call 9.
D. Optional, only after A-C are measured: gemma:2b as the second course-model candidate on the same six questions.
not_changed: No code, prompt, config, label or split was modified in this pilot. No model substitution.
